description: This implementation uses the MLCommons Storage v2.0 reference code with Alluxio 3.6.0 mounted in FUSE mode pointing to AWS S3. System config: 2 clients, 2 servers, 32 total accelerators.
run_command: mlpstorage training run --hosts 127.0.0.1 --num-client-hosts 2 --client-host-memory-in-gb 100 --num-accelerators 32 --accelerator-type H100 --model resnet50  --data-dir /mnt/alluxio/alluxio-fuse/s3/resnet50_7485_999GB --results-dir /home/ubuntu/mlps_results  --param dataset.num_files_train=7485 --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe
